simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַדְמַנָּה (Madmannâh) means Madmannah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 49.

definitions.full: H4089. Madmannah מַדְמַנָּה 1. proper name, of a location city of southern Judah Josh 15:31 ; location dubious, Onomasticon Μηδεβηνα = Μηνοεις near Gaza Lag Onom. 279, 2nd ed. 276 ; compare Minyay south of Gaza Rob BR i. 602 ; on other proposed identification compare Di. 2. proper name, masculine descendant of Caleb 1Chr 2:49 .
